Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Description:
Find the plugin you want without hunting through repository lists. Omega brings official and community Dalamud plugins into one searchable storefront with Spotlight, screenshots, tags, compatibility, source choice, and Sigmascope evidence.

Open Omega with /omega or /omg. Discover plugins, compare repositories, inspect Sigmascope findings, install through Dalamud, and keep your Library and Updates together.
Changelog: Unreleased work build: make Sigmascope catalog handoff resilient for scheduled/manual runs and preserve downloadable diagnostics even when the handoff fails. Final release notes are assigned when a GitHub tag is cut.
